name: App volumes that stick
description: A WirePlumber 0.5 script that keeps each app's volume from the mixer when the app sets its own: as it opens a stream, resumes, or moves to the next item. Spotify sets its own 100% again on every track. A volume set in the mixer then holds across tracks and restarts.
notes: WirePlumber loads the app-volumes script when it next starts: systemctl --user restart wireplumber (sound stops for about a second).
